objectives_fil: Sa fictional na kaso, sa fictional map, ituro ang hazard, pangangailangang suportahan at isang kakayahang kailangang kumpirmahin.
objectives_en: In a fictional case, on the fictional map, identify a hazard, a support need and one capacity needing confirmation.

sections.takeaway_fil: Sa fictional map, ituro ang hazard, pangangailangang suportahan at isang kakayahang kailangang kumpirmahin.
sections.takeaway_en: On the fictional map, identify a hazard, a support need and one capacity needing confirmation.

sections.takeaway_fil: Ikinokonekta nito ang pagpapasya sa beripikadong plano at saklaw.
sections.takeaway_en: This ties action to a verified plan and scope.

check.prompt_fil: Ano ang unang ligtas na hakbang?
check.prompt_en: What is the first safe step?

options.fil: Ipagpalagay na tama pa ang lumang impormasyon at agad itong ipasa sa lahat.
options.en: Assume the old information is still correct and immediately relay it to everyone.

options.fil: Ihiwalay ang hazard, suporta at kapasidad; ipa-verify ang ruta at shelter.
options.en: Separate hazard, support need and capacity; verify route and shelter.

options.fil: Magpasiya mag-isa nang walang lokal na kumpirmasyon o opisyal na babala.
options.en: Decide alone without local confirmation or an official warning.

check.feedback_fil: 1: Maaaring luma o mali ang impormasyon. 2: Ikinokonekta nito ang pagpapasya sa beripikadong plano at saklaw. 3: Kailangan ang tamang awtoridad at lokal na konteksto.
check.feedback_en: 1: Information may be old or wrong. 2: This ties action to a verified plan and scope. 3: The correct authority and local context are needed.

sections.takeaway_fil: Sa fictional na kaso, sa fictional map, ituro ang hazard, pangangailangang suportahan at isang kakayahang kailangang kumpirmahin.
sections.takeaway_en: In a fictional case, on the fictional map, identify a hazard, a support need and one capacity needing confirmation.

sections.takeaway_fil: Kumpirmahin ang saklaw at kailangan sa tamang tao.
sections.takeaway_en: Confirm boundaries and requirements with the appropriate person.

sections.takeaway_fil: Tinitiyak nito ang malinaw na pananagutan at susunod na aksiyon.
sections.takeaway_en: This establishes clear ownership and next action.

check.prompt_fil: Alin ang ligtas na susunod na hakbang?
check.prompt_en: What is the safe next step?

options.fil: Sabihing bukas ang paaralan kahit hindi pa nasuri. Huwag nang tanungin ang awtoridad o ang taong apektado.
options.en: Say the school is open without checking. Do not ask the authority or the affected person.

options.fil: Walang kailangang itala o balikan kahit hindi pa natatanggap ng tamang team.
options.en: Nothing needs recording or follow-up even without team acknowledgement.

options.fil: Ipaabot sa lead, itala ang handover, at balikan.
options.en: Inform the lead, record handover, and follow up.

check.feedback_fil: 1: Maaaring makapinsala o maantala ang tulong. 2: Nawawala ang accountability at continuity. 3: Tinitiyak nito ang malinaw na pananagutan at susunod na aksiyon.
check.feedback_en: 1: This may harm or delay help. 2: Accountability and continuity are lost. 3: This establishes clear ownership and next action.

sections.takeaway_fil: Subukan ang gawain at balikan ang resulta.
sections.takeaway_en: Try the task and review the result.
